title: THOMAS MULLER JUST CALLED MLS CARELESS. HE PLAYS IN IT!
description:
Thomas Muller has a problem with MLS, and he plays in it.

The Whitecaps forward told Global News that no relegation changes how players defend. In Europe, bottom clubs fight to survive, and relegation hits budgets, staff and fans. In MLS, nobody checks the bottom of the table.

Muller says players feel less pressure, so their focus fades over ninety minutes. Like most of us in a long meeting.

It was not all criticism. He praised the attacking football and the individual moments. Quality, he says, is less consistent. Praise first, then the but.

He joined Vancouver in August and has renewed his deal. Honest, and still staying.

Does relegation make football better, or is MLS fine without it? Sound off below.
